1753-3755-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

618-728-6966.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of All-Fates Stalker.
When the All-Fates Stalker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the All-Fates Stalker token.
When the All-Fates Stalker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1496-1981-2415-3967.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1496-1981-2415-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1170-2829-5131-7054--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2829-5131-7054--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Gravebreaker Lamia.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager
Repeat.

620-2111-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

4369-5929-7855.notablePrerequisites: You are able to put a counter on The Red Terror.
4369-5929-7855.description:
Put a counter on The Red Terror.
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, as The Red Terror is a Goblin, Orc or Army due to Leyline of Transformation, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2459-3661-5049-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
2459-3661-5049-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1263-4871-5256-6026.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1453-4613-5446-7150.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures, one of which must have a +1/+1 counter on it and hasn't used Kirol's ability this turn.
1453-4613-5446-7150.description:
Cast Esika's Chariot by paying {3}{G}.
When Esika's Chariot enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it using Kirol's ability by tapping two creatures you control, copying Esika's Chariot's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Esika's Chariot's trigger, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens, which each enter with a +1/+1 counter on them due to Arwen.
Repeat from step 3, using one of the Cats to activate Kirol's ability, and then tapping both Cats.

1123-2292-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
1123-2292-6972.notes: If Flayer of the Hatebound starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

3169-4050-7495-7498.description:
Cast a copy of All Aboard by paying {U}, blinking Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Biblioplex Tomekeeper trigger, preparing Skycoach Conductor.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1394-2060-2265-5231-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Hardened Scales.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Hardened Scales.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

147-3771-7300.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least X +1/+1 counters on it.
147-3771-7300.description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Dualcaster Mage.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage from exile by paying {2} reduced to Animar.
Repeat from step 3.
147-3771-7300.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {2} if Animar starts with +1/+1 counters.

1322-3259-3986.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control creatures with total power 6 or greater that can attack this combat.
1322-3259-3986.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers. If needed, declare more creatures as attackers to ensure that the total power of attacking creatures is 6 or greater.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1563-3899-4885-6705.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

104-1545-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1003-2921-4053-6989.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1289-4311-5078-5864.notablePrerequisites: Birds of Paradise does not have summoning sickness.
1289-4311-5078-5864.description:
Activate Birds of Paradise by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Repeat.

1458-5034-5864.notablePrerequisites: You control a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog that does not have summoning sickness.
1458-5034-5864.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a Bird, Rat, Otter and/or Frog you control that does not have summoning sickness.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve Banishing Knack.
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

3933-4772-4929-5479.notablePrerequisites:
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3933-4772-4929-5479.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4}, putting two charge counters on Lost Jitte and two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

2136-2972-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Orthion.
2136-2972-4222.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Ganax with haste.
Put each Ganax token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Ganax triggers five times, for a total of thirty triggers, creating thirty Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate ten Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{U}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Orthion.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, you may then target any other creature using Orthion's ability.

63-1558-4231-4428.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Wernog.
When Wernog leaves and enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve both triggers, creating at least two Clue, two Food and two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1642-4794.description:
Cast Fraying Omnipotence by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to lose half their life, then discard half the cards in their hand, then sacrifice half the creatures they control, rounding up each time.
At the beginning of your end step, Warlock Class triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they have lost this turn.

813-1181-5188.description:
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven {B}.
Cast Dread Return by paying {2}{B}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Sacrifice and Dread Return from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1020-1117-2866-4659-5034.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
Myr Retriever dies, triggering itself and Scrap Trawler.
Resolve the Myr Retriever trigger, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Scrap Trawler trigger, returning Sol Ring from your hand to your graveyard.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sol Ring, adding {C}{C}.
Scrap Trawler triggers, choose not to return an artifact to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {3}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.
Junk Diver dies, triggering itself and Scrap Trawler.
Resolve the Junk Diver trigger, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Scrap Trawler trigger, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 5-8 one additional time.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Repeat from step 1.

168-736-4948-5290.description:
Cast Estrid's Invocation by paying {2}{U}.
Estrid's Invocation enters the battlefield as a copy of Oblivion Ring, triggering Sage of Mysteries and itself.
Resolve the Sage of Mysteries trigger, causing target player to mill two cards.
Resolve the Estrid's Invocation's trigger, exiling Oblivion Ring until it leaves the battlefield.
Cast Copy Enchantment by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Copy Enchantment enters the battlefield as a copy of Estrid's invocation, triggering Sage of Mysteries and itself.
Resolve the Sage of Mysteries trigger, causing target player to mill two cards.
Resolve the Copy Enchantment's trigger, exiling Estrid's Invocation until it leaves the battlefield.
Estrid's Invocation leaves the battlefield, returning Oblivion Ring from exile to the battlefield.
Sage of Mysteries and Oblivion Ring triggers.
Resolve the Sage of Mysteries trigger, causing target player to mill two cards.
Resolve the Oblivion Ring's trigger, exiling Copy Enchantment.
Copy Enchantment leaves the battlefield, returning Estrid's Invocation from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
